messages:
maya: saw an uptick of 502s from hosted-api customers around 10:14 UTC, lots of streaming calls failing mid-stream. first noticed from a high-volume tenant (trace ids in logs).

alex: on it. are these only streaming endpoints or also sync generate/embed calls?

maya: mostly streaming (chunked responses), but a few blocked non-stream requests too. metrics: 502 rate + auth-rejects spiked together. sample access log: 
```
[10:15:02] ingress edge1 env=prod method=POST path=/v1/streams status=502 upstream_reset: STREAM_RESET reason=RST_STREAM(2) trace=trc_0a1b2c3d
```

kevin: seeing lots of upstream connpool exhaustion on Envoy stats (`cluster.upstream_rq_active > 1000`), and `upstream_cx_overflow` increments. Also auth cache TTL churned during the 10:00 deploy window.

lia: can you paste an example request we can use to repro? customer said multipart and chunked bodies interleaved.

maya: here's a minimal repro they shared (sanitized):
```
curl -v -X POST https://hosted.api.redwood.com/v1/streams \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----X" \
  --data-binary $'------X\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="p.bin"\r\nContent-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n<binary-chunks>\r\n------X--\r\n' --http2
```

alex: tried a few local runs — after ~200 concurrent chunked uploads, Envoy reports `connection reset by peer` to upstream (auth-proxy). Looks like auth proxy is flapping when the token refresh service returns 5xx for a subset of tenant keys. When auth fails, we short-circuit to a 502 path instead of throttling gracefully.

kevin: correlate with auth-service: logs show many `kv-get` timeouts and a sudden surge of `auth-cache-miss` followed by token fetch retries. token refresh job was rolled out at ~09:58 UTC in canary.

maya: customer-facing: "we see 502 mid-stream, sometimes 504, then client retries and things get worse". They included a trace: `trc_0a1b2c3d` which matches our ingress.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2048, pager duty alerted to eng-sre and oncall.

lia: quick mitigation ideas: 1) enable auth-cache fallback to safe-stale for 30s, 2) add a short token-fetch exponential backoff so token service doesn't avalanche, 3) temporarily rate-limit large chunked uploads per-tenant at LB. Which is fastest?

alex: 1 and 2 are config flips. I can patch auth-cache TTL fallback and enable backoff in the token fetcher; should be a config toggle to unbreak in ~5–10min. kevin can we also add an L7 short-circuit on content-length > 100MB to reject with 429 instead of letting the upstream hit the auth hotpath?

kevin: yes I can push a transient rate-limit rule on the edge (nginx map + envoy route) in ~15m. will scope to the affected tenant IDs.

maya: steps to reproduce for eng: run a 250-concurrency script using the curl above but rotate Authorization headers (to simulate token churn) — we see auth-cache-miss amplification.

alex: logs I captured:
```
[09:59:12] auth-fetch error=fatal status=502 body="KV timeout" tenant=tn_123
[09:59:13] auth-cache: miss tenant=tn_123
[09:59:13] ingress: upstream reset code=ECONNRESET to auth-proxy
[10:00:02] ingress: returned 502 to client stream-id=45 trace=trc_0a1b2c3d
```

lia: I'm flipping auth-cache fallback now (safe-stale=30s) and enabling token-fetch backoff (initial 200ms, max 2s). notify when done.

lia: flipped both. monitoring.

[+15m] kevin: applied tenant-scoped rate-limit: chunked uploads >100MB now get a 429 at edge. also temporarily increased `cluster.max_connections` for auth-proxy pool to reduce overflow.

maya: seeing 502s drop to baseline in the next 10min window. streaming success rate returning. customers confirm a lot fewer errors.

alex: follow-ups: 1) investigate why token fetch rollouts created KV latency — maybe a dependent redis/kv cluster GC. 2) make ingress treat auth failures as 429/503 fallback for streaming instead of hard 502 mid-stream. 3) add test harness for mixed chunked+multipart payloads under high concurrency.

kevin: I'll keep the tenant rate-limit until we have a durable fix and add a dashboard panel for `auth-cache-miss rate` and `upstream_cx_overflow`.

maya: escalation thread wrap-up for support: customers notified of workaround and next steps; link to incident INC-2048. the tenant requested root-cause and ETA for permanent fix.

deploy-bot: Deploy reverted: token-refresh-service v2.3.1 -> v2.2.9 (rollback) at 10:42 UTC.

alex: rollback reduced KV timeouts — suspected regression in v2.3.1 that changed retry behavior and increased KV load. we'll schedule a canary with improved backoff logic.

maya: thanks all. logging the repro script and curl command in the incident runbook. closing the support escalation as "mitigated, monitoring" but keeping incident open for RCA. :white_check_mark:
